name: tracetoon
description: PRs with receipts. And comics. Tracetoon turns the session logs of Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and 11 more coding agents into a pull request where every claim is checked against what actually ran, with a comic on top.

interface.longDescription: PRs with receipts. And comics. Tracetoon turns the session logs of Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and 11 more coding agents into a pull request where every claim is checked against what actually ran, with a comic on top. It creates or updates the PR with the GitHub CLI; needs git and gh signed in. Comic images go to an image service only after you approve one.
defaultPrompt: Open a PR for this branch with Tracetoon.
